text: THE DBIM HOME PAGE'S MINISTER HEADSHOTS ARE SQUARE AND ON WHITE. DBIM 3.0 §6.1.4 asks for 1:1 headshots on a white background; the frames were 240 × 206 (183 × 206 on a phone) on the pale grey ground. They are now 240 × 240 and 183 × 183, white, with the grey rule and the key-colour bar kept. The Figma handoff's Minister component matches.
